title: Consent Ledger Entry v1.0
description: Shape of ONE line of projects/{slug}/_state/consent.jsonl — the append-only, hash-chained ledger recording operator consent for an irreversible/outward action. The recorder (scripts/state/consent_ledger.py, AMO batch 2a) appends one entry per `/pseo-approve`; the PreToolUse outward-action gate (batch 2b) hashes a pending action's concrete target and calls has_consent(run_id, action, target_hash) before allowing it. Hash-chained: entry_hash = sha256(canonical_json(this entry WITHOUT entry_hash)); prev_hash = the prior line's entry_hash (or 64 zeros for the first line) — so a forged, rewritten, or reordered entry breaks the chain and is rejected. This is an append-only LOG (events.jsonl discipline; rules/append-only-state.md), NEVER an os.replace marker.

schema_version.description: ADR-018/019 const discipline; lets a future migration discriminate older entries. Optional (not in required[]).

seq.description: 0-based monotonic index of this entry within the file. seq 0 is the genesis line (prev_hash = 64 zeros). verify_chain asserts seq increments by exactly 1.

run_id.description: The run (or manual token) this consent is scoped to. Usually a workflow run_id {slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD}-{hash4}, but PERMISSIVE (minLength:1) to allow a standalone manual approval. The gate matches by EXACT string equality.

action.description: The class of gated outward action consent is granted for. git_push=`git push`; fs_delete=rm/unlink/rmdir/shred; net_post=outbound curl/wget POST (exfil surface); mcp_submit=an MCP submit tool (e.g. mcp__gsc__submit_sitemap); index_update=Google Indexing-API URL_UPDATED (Süleyman hard-consent); dfs_oversized=an oversized DataForSEO request. Batch 2b maps each gate matcher onto exactly one of these. Additive enum bump if a new gated class is added later.

target.description: Human-readable concrete target the consent is for (the URL, file path, sitemap, command). Optional but recommended for audit; target_hash is the matchable key.

target_hash.description: sha256 hex of the canonical target string (UTF-8). The gate computes the SAME hash of a pending action's concrete target and looks it up, so writer and gate MUST hash identically (use consent_ledger.target_hash()).

granted_at.description: Canonical UTC ISO 8601 with a 'Z' suffix (…S.%fZ) when consent was granted. format:date-time is enforced by the strict checker (rules/time-discipline.md §8.10) — naive/non-UTC/+00:00 values are rejected; the recorder stamps datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ').

granted_by.description: Who granted it (e.g. 'operator', a session id, or a name) — provenance for the audit trail.

session_id.description: The Claude session UUID that granted consent, if known. Optional provenance.

prev_hash.description: entry_hash of the PRIOR line, or 64 zeros ('0'*64) for the genesis line (seq 0). The chain link.

entry_hash.description: sha256 hex over canonical_json of THIS entry with entry_hash removed (all other fields, incl. prev_hash, present). Tamper-evidence: recomputing must reproduce this value.
